input.command: cat etl_pipeline.py; find etl -name "*.py" | xargs wc -l; grep -rn "def validate\|def _validate\|UNKNOWN_OP" etl | head -40
cat etl/steps.py etl/fields.py etl/request.py etl/errors.py etl/ops/common.py
cd etl/ops; grep -n "def normalize\|def check\|raw\[\|raw.get\|class .*(\(Field\|Text\|Label\|List\|Map\|Record\|Expr\|Choice\))" *.py; grep -n "fields = " *.py | head -60
